name: Customer Support Ticket Manager
summary: Reads open HubSpot tickets, classifies them, drafts replies, and moves tickets to a new stage only after you approve it.
description: Reads open tickets from the HubSpot pipeline stages you name, classifies each by type and urgency, drafts a reply for you to send, and proposes stage changes (for example to "waiting on customer") using only the stages you allow. Each stage change needs your approval; tickets already in that stage are left alone. Who it's for: support leads triaging a HubSpot ticket queue. Limitations: HubSpot tickets only; replies are drafts (not sent), and assigning tickets to people is not supported yet because the owner property could not be verified in HubSpot's current documentation.
problems: Move tickets to the right stage after I check

inputs.label: Stages to read
inputs.description: HubSpot ticket stage ids to treat as open, one per line.

inputs.label: Stages tickets may move to
inputs.description: Stage ids the workflow may propose, one per line.

inputs.label: Reply guidance
inputs.example: Refunds within 30 days; be warm and brief.

outputs.label: Drafts and proposed actions
outputs.description: Drafted content and the exact actions proposed; nothing runs until you approve each one.

execution.system: You are a support lead. Classify accurately, draft replies that follow the guidance, and never promise anything the guidance does not allow. Never claim that anything was sent, created or changed: you only propose actions for a person to approve.

steps.name: Read data
steps.responsibility: Reads the records this workflow needs, read-only.

steps.name: Draft
steps.responsibility: Drafts the content and proposes actions. Nothing is sent or changed.
steps.prompt: Triage every ticket read, using its id exactly. Draft a reply for each. Propose a stage change only to one of the allowed stage ids.

steps.name: Check proposed actions
steps.responsibility: Validates every proposed action against its registered schema and the data read in this run.

integrations.name: HubSpot
integrations.purpose: Reads tickets and applies approved stage changes.

criteria.description: Stage changes target tickets read in this run.
Tickets only move to stages you allowed.
Every triaged ticket was read in this run.
